name: University of Greenwich

facts.text: The University of Greenwich has two London-based campuses and one at Medway in Kent.
Greenwich holds a Teaching Excellence Framework Gold Award and is a member of University Alliance.
Greenwich has historic campuses and students from more than 150 countries, and is rated Top 5 in London by StudentCrowd.

CAS Shield is Greenwich's online self-service system: once you accept your offer and pay any deposit, the university emails a CAS Shield invitation and you upload your information and documents there.

sources.notes: Practice UKVI interview happens 'after you have an unconditional offer and paid any required deposit'; invitation 'via CAS Shield (or be sent an email)' and you 'choose a time and date'. Format is either 'A video interview recorded on CAS Shield' or 'A face-to-face interview (conducted on Microsoft Teams)'. Outcome: 'we will review your answers and come back to you with some feedback. If we have concerns about any of your answers, we may ask you to attend another interview.' 'We do not require all applicants to have a practice interview.' Page links to a 'Credibility Interview Guidance' document (not fetched). No length stated.

sources.title: Getting your CAS | Visas and Immigration for study in the UK | University of Greenwich
sources.notes: Snippet: 'Some international offer holders may be required to complete a Practice UKVI interview with the CAS team prior to being issued their CAS. Offer holders are invited via CAS Shield to participate in these interviews and can choose a time and date.' Also: based on visa refusal risk some students may be asked to pay 100% of tuition fees upfront before a CAS is issued, and 'should not pay this until they have passed their credibility interview'. Nepal listed in Group A countries for CAS processing (snippet).
